premise: Clouds gather and everyone hurries home — Beaver to his lodge, Badger to his burrow, Bird to his nest — each worrying about Snail, who isn't hurrying at all, because his house is on his back.
inspiration: Zeus and the Tortoise (Aesop), where carrying your house is a punishment; turned: it's a gift, and Snail is the one who stays dry.
lesson: What makes you different can be exactly what you need.
learning: A snail carries its shell, its house, wherever it goes.

en-US.title: Snail Brought His House
en-US.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7 30s} [rushed] Grey clouds rolled in. Rain was coming! Everyone hurried home. {beaver:enter} Beaver stopped by {snail:enter} Snail. {beaver:go to snail} {beaver:face surprised} Snail! Where's your house? {snail:face happy} Right here, said Snail. So Beaver {beaver:live} gnawed him a stick for a roof. Just in case, he said. And {beaver:go away} off he hurried to his lodge. {badger:enter} {badger:go to snail} Badger stopped by. {badger:face surprised} Snail! Where's your house? Right here. So Badger {badger:live} dug him a little hole. Just in case, he said. And {badger:go away} off he hurried to his burrow. {bird:enter} {bird:go to snail} Bird swooped down. {bird:face surprised} Snail! Where's your house? [giggles] Right HERE, said Snail. Off {bird:go away} flew Bird to his nest. {canvas:rain 0.8 14s} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter, down came the rain. {snail:live hold} Snail tucked himself into his shell. {sfx:taps} Tap, tap, went the rain on his roof. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 16s} When the sun came out, {beaver:go back} {badger:go back} {bird:go back} back came his friends. {badger:face sad} [whispers] Snail? Are you wet? {snail:live resume} Out peeked Snail, dry as a daisy. {snail:face happy} I told you. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [happily] My house goes wherever I go.

es-ES.title: Caracol lleva su casa
es-ES.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7 30s} [rushed] Llegaban nubes grises. ¡Iba a llover! Todos corrían a casa. {beaver:enter} Castor se paró junto a {snail:enter} Caracol. {beaver:go to snail} {beaver:face surprised} ¡Caracol! ¿Dónde está tu casa? {snail:face happy} Aquí mismo, dijo Caracol. Así que Castor {beaver:live} le royó un tejadito de palo. Por si acaso, dijo. Y {beaver:go away} se fue corriendo a casa. Llegó {badger:enter} {badger:go to snail} Tejón. {badger:face surprised} ¡Caracol! ¿Dónde está tu casa? Aquí mismo, dijo Caracol. Así que Tejón {badger:live} le cavó un agujerito. Por si acaso, dijo. Y {badger:go away} se fue corriendo a su madriguera. {bird:enter} {bird:go to snail} Pájaro bajó volando. {bird:face surprised} ¡Caracol! ¿Dónde está tu casa? [giggles] ¡Aquí MISMO!, dijo Caracol. Y {bird:go away} Pájaro voló a su nido. {canvas:rain 0.8 14s} {sfx:rain} Plic, plic, empezó a llover. {snail:live hold} Caracol se metió en su concha. {sfx:taps} Tip, tap, sonaba la lluvia en su tejado. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 16s} Cuando salió el sol, {beaver:go back} {badger:go back} {bird:go back} volvieron sus amigos. {badger:face sad} [whispers] ¿Caracol? ¿Estás mojado? {snail:live resume} Caracol asomó, sequito como una margarita. {snail:face happy} Ya os lo decía yo. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [happily] Mi casa va conmigo a todas partes.
